dataset_title: PT Badak NGL Train H C3MR DCS-to-HYSYS Operating Reconciliation Dataset (P1-P100)

columns.percentile: Empirical production percentile (P1 = minimum turndown, P100 = maximum baseload)
columns.operating_hours_yr: Exact empirical duration hours from historical timestamp distribution
columns.feed_gas_flow_kNm3_h: Raw incoming feed gas volumetric rate from tag H1FI0009
columns.feed_gas_flow_t_h: Feed gas mass flow rate converted using molecular weight
columns.feed_gas_press_kgcm2g: Feed gas boundary limit pressure from tag H1PIC033
Feed gas mole fractions from chromatograph 1E-1 (N2, C1, C2, C3)
columns.lng_prod_mass_t_h: LNG production rate from target energy calculation
columns.lng_rundown_temp_C: LNG rundown temperature to storage from tag H5TIC01A
columns.mcr_mass_flow_t_h: MCR mass circulation rate from target energy calculation
MCR composition mole fractions from chromatograph 4C-8
columns.c3_suct_p_kgcm2a: Propane 1st stage suction pressure from tag H4PIC002
columns.c3_disch_p_kgcm2a: Propane discharge pressure to condenser from tag H4PI006B
columns.c3_turb_speed_rpm: Propane turbine 4KT-1 rotational speed from tag H4SI018A
columns.c3_turb_steam_t_h: Propane turbine 4KT-1 steam consumption from condensate tag H4FI031A
columns.mcr_lp_suct_p_kgcm2a: MCR LP compressor suction pressure from tag H4PI014B
columns.mcr_lp_disch_p_kgcm2a: MCR LP compressor discharge pressure from tag H4PI016B
columns.mcr_lp_suct_t_C: MCR LP compressor suction temperature from tag H4TI004B (TAL >= -45.0 C)
columns.mcr_lp_turb_speed_rpm: MCR LP turbine 4KT-2 rotational speed from tag H4SI023A
columns.mcr_lp_turb_steam_t_h: MCR LP turbine 4KT-2 steam consumption from condensate tag H4FI029A
columns.mcr_hp_suct_p_kgcm2a: MCR HP compressor suction pressure from tag H4PI016B
columns.mcr_hp_disch_p_kgcm2a: MCR HP compressor discharge pressure from tag H4PI017B
columns.mcr_hp_turb_speed_rpm: MCR HP turbine 4KT-3 rotational speed from tag H4SI028A
columns.mcr_hp_turb_steam_t_h: MCR HP turbine 4KT-3 steam consumption from condensate tag H4FI030A
columns.total_driver_steam_t_h: Sum of all mechanical-drive steam turbine flows (4KT-1 + 4KT-2 + 4KT-3)
columns.total_compressor_power_steam_MW: Shaft power equivalent derived from 4.04 t/MWh steam rate
columns.boiler_fuel_gas_kNm3_h: Total fuel gas rate consumed by Unit 31 boilers (31FIC0321-329)
columns.boiler_steam_t_h: Total HP steam generation from Unit 31 boilers (FI00621A-629A)
columns.measured_fuel_to_steam_ratio_Nm3_t: DCS-measured boiler fuel-to-steam conversion ratio (mean = 79.33-79.97 Nm3/t)
